name: Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja Storm 4 - Evolution
summary: The Evolution team took Naruto Storm 4, a game with an abundance of content but no future patches, and are providing the players a polished, more unique experience. Through communication, polling, and rigorous testing, we are able to make changes to improve the player experience, add/modify existing content with the help of contributions, and push changes out via updates. Whether you play competitively or for fun, we aim to provide the best experience possible with Evolution!
